findings.title: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled requires user != null, which drops passkeys from normal login
Call to non-existent no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body:
`UsernameForm.authenticate` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments. The only method added to the superclass `UsernamePasswordForm` is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, and no zero-argument overload exists in the class hierarchy.

This is a compilation error, so the services module will not build. It needs to pass `context.getUser()` or a no-arg overload must be added.
